page.layout: One narrow column of small-type entries, with the page number 292 at the head. No running head, catchword or signature in this part.; One table in two columns on the left: consul names on the left, paired years (1488–1495) in the middle and (1496–1502) on the right, with symbols beside some years. Partial marginal notes at the lower right, beside the table. A catchword "Eppo" below the table, at the right.

p.i: Ioan. Tedema videtur aut perperā poni aut mortuum esse in consulatu.

page.notes: The entry "famo" is read as printed, with [?]; the word may be "fano". "Leo-ardiis" is copied as the line break shows it, with [?]. The first two entries appear in italic type, read here as italic. No other doubtful readings. The right-hand years carry symbols (*, †, ‡, ⁑) whose exact forms and alignment with the groups are doubtful. The marginal fragments at lower right are only partly legible and are marked [?]. The catchword "Eppo" is printed under the table.
